end Nl2LeanExpected

  have h3 : a - b ≥ 0 := by linarith [h1]
  have h4 : a - c ≥ 0 := by linarith [h2]

  have h6 : a + (a - b - c) ≥ a := by linarith [h5]
  have h7 : a ≥ b + c := by linarith [h6]
  exact h7
end Nl2LeanCandidate
